name: Oven Beef Shawarma with Pita and Tahini Sauce

components.name: Beef Shawarma

ingredients.name: Raw lean flank steak, thinly cut across grain

steps: Cut beef into narrow even strips and combine with oil, vinegar, lemon, garlic, onion and spices; refrigerate covered for at least 1 hour.
Heat oven to 225 C. Spread the meat across two preheated baking sheets without crowding so it roasts rather than steams.
Roast in short batches, turning at least once; monitor thick pieces with a thermometer, since thin beef strips overcook quickly. Use fully cooked beef for future reheating.
Cool and portion the beef and onions into eight containers. Store wraps, sliced vegetables and tahini separately so diners can assemble after reheating.

components.name: Flatbread & Fresh Vegetables

ingredients.name: Shredded cabbage or raw pepper strips

steps: Reheat beef until steaming hot throughout, then fill bread with measured sauce and vegetables.

components.name: Tahini Sauce
steps: Whisk tahini with lemon and garlic, adding water a little at a time until it becomes spoonable, then season.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Oven adaptation of Feel Good Foodie stovetop beef shawarma; original method differs. Includes measured bread and tahini to form complete meal.
Planning: Oven may be used for beef; cold assembly needed. Grill or pan remains an optional alternative.
Freezer: freeze cooked beef; tahini may change texture; fresh vegetables added later
Dietary: Contains sesame and wheat. Check shawarma spice additives.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
